content:
Jun: GIF + sticker showdown? post your best holiday GIF and one sticker you'd give someone for 2026. prizes: glory and a digital sticker pack. :tada:
Marta: love it. categories: Most Chaotic GIF, Most Heartwarming, and Best Sticker Name.
Devon: i have a loaded folder of chaotic christmas lights gifs. danger: may cause spontaneous desktop dancing.
Sonia: can we also do a tiny gratitude chain? every gif post should include a 1-liner thanking a coworker. micro kindnesses only.
Jun: yes to gratitude chain 60a tag the person you're thanking.
reactions-bot: Reminder: Please keep entries workplace-appropriate. React with :white_check_mark: to join.
Marta: joined 44d first entry: GIF https://files.redwood.example/gif-marta-sled.gif Sticker name: "Bugfix Bravo" thanking @Devon for helping with the beta deploy last week.
Devon: joined 44d posted GIF https://files.redwood.example/gif-devon-lights.gif Sticker name: "Latency Slayer" thanking @Sonia for late-night monitoring.
Sonia: posted GIF https://files.redwood.example/gif-sonia-cozy-cat.gif Sticker name: "Snack Santa" thanking @Jun for the quick design review that saved my Monday.
Jun: posted GIF https://files.redwood.example/gif-jun-snowloop.gif Sticker name: "Merge Elf" thanking @Marta for catching that logger typo.
Marta: small fun rule: one-liners only, no long essays. keeps the chain snappy.
Devon: voting: people's choice via emoji. i'll start a poll message pinned to this thread. judges (me + Jun) pick Most Chaotic.
reactions-bot: Poll created: People's Choice ends in 36 hours. Use reactions to vote.
Sonia: also, can we compile a tiny 2-minute montage of the top 5 GIFs for the winter wrap? i can edit together if winners OK.
Jun: yes please. winners, reply here if you want montage inclusion.
Marta: reacted :sparkles: to Sonia (include me)
Devon: reacted :sparkles: (include me)
Sonia: noted 4f9 will include captions with the gratitude lines.
Marta: bonus idea: the sticker with the funniest name gets a silly trophy emoji in slack profile for a week.
Jun: loving the trophy idea. small rewards, big vibes.
reactions-bot: Reminder: Poll ends 2026-12-22 12:00 PT.
Devon: caption add-on for my GIF: "found leftover lights in ops closet, immediate consequences"
Sonia: caption add-on: "cat insisted on supervising string deployment"
Jun: caption add-on: "snow loop courtesy of one too many filter experiments"
Marta: last call to post entries. posting wraps up in ~4 hours. thanks for doing the gratitude chain, everyone 49a
